picks.name: Sascha Funke
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Kompakt. Previously came up empty on 11-09 before this album was confirmed out.
picks.bio: "Planes In Reverse" (November 6, 2026, Kompakt, cat. KOMPAKTCD189D) is Sascha Funke's fourth album and first full-length on Kompakt in nearly a decade -- ten tracks spanning techno, house, minimalism and disco house, with Julienne Dessagne of Fantastic Twins featured on the title track.
picks.why_listen: A veteran Berlin producer's long-awaited album return -- varied enough to work across several different moods in a set.

picks.name: Bodhi
picks.source_note: Hotflush Recordings already seeded. New artist discovery.
picks.bio: "Echoic" (November 13, 2026, Hotflush Recordings) is a seven-track EP from Cardiff duo Bodhi (Luke Welsby and Olly Howells), whose UK bass/house sound draws on disco, garage and bassline, with standout cuts "Clippa" and "Quaresma Dub."
picks.why_listen: Groovy, bassline-driven UK bass with a garage edge -- good for a bouncier, bass-forward stretch of a set.
